name: Event-Driven Architecture (Broker Topology)
catalog_source: Richards & Ford (2020), Ch. 14; Bass et al. (2021), Ch. 13
forces_resolved: Ultra-high throughput via asynchronous non-blocking event publishing
Extreme horizontal scalability with dynamic consumer scaling
High decoupling between event producers and consumers
forces_unresolved: Eventual consistency and race conditions across consumers
Distributed transaction failure recovery requires compensating sagas
Difficult end-to-end distributed tracing and testing
applicability_conditions: Event streaming, IoT telemetry, high-throughput notifications, and async order processing
Workloads where consumer processes are independent and fire-and-forget
anti_requisites: Strict immediate read-after-write ACID consistency across domains
Teams lacking distributed observability and Kafka/RabbitMQ expertise
